content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

The real architecture behind Bitcoin payments for digital downloads is a sovereign commerce stack that decouples digital creators from centralized payment platforms. This stack is built on free and paid tools, such as GitHub Pages, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-5|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages, Supabase, Google Drive, and NOWPayments, which enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with no buyer account required. By owning their digital commerce infrastructure, creators can scale their businesses without platform fees and maintain full control over their data and revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture works by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate delivery of digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and templates. When a customer makes a payment through NOWPayments, a webhook fires immediately, triggering the delivery of the product to the customer's email or download link. This seamless process is made possible by the integration of Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed for digital creators who sell digital products, such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, but cannot collect payment through conventional platforms. This includes creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Payhip are unavailable or severely restricted, as well as those who want to reduce platform fees and increase revenue.
Decoupling from centralized payment platforms can increase revenue and creative freedom for digital creators.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of COREMERCH's sovereign commerce stack include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. By integrating these tools, creators can build a scalable and secure digital commerce infrastructure that meets their needs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, follow these concrete steps: Start by choosing a hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up a backend logic tool, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, integrate order storage and file delivery tools, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, connect your stack to a payment gateway, such as NOWPayments, and configure your products and pricing. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), available for instant download, you can have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
